testcase.name: Given a pool that allows 10 unreserved items, when I ask for 20, then I expect 10 items and 10 nulls
Given a pool without available players, when I require a player, then I expect an exception
Given an empty pool, when I require a player, then I expect a player
Given an ExoPlayer not in the pool, when I pool it, then I expect an IllegalArgumentException
Given a pool that allows 10 items and has all items checked out, when I return then check them all out again, then I expect 10 non null players
